adversarial.expectation: a pattern-lookalike (root letter resembling an augment) fixture is present and marked adversarial; a fixture set without adversarial rows fails

positive.expectation: place-noun concepts map to the bank's place-noun error class with at least one positive and one adversarial fixture

commands.expect: one row per (concept, error_class) pair with coverage flags
commands.purpose: map each L3 derivation concept node to the eval-bank error classes
commands.run: python - (inline: join graph/concepts.jsonl domain=derivation rows against sarf/evals/nominal-derivative-error-eval.jsonl error classes; emit crosswalk rows)

commands.expect: fixtures carry source claim ids and status candidate
commands.purpose: author clean-room fixture rows for uncovered classes using independently selected standard examples
commands.run: python - (inline: for each uncovered class, add a fixture row with an independently chosen word, positive + adversarial variant)

defeaters: a produced row conflicts with a repo-certified fact -> record as contradicted, do not overwrite
the private corpus is unavailable -> metadata-only steps proceed; body-reading steps abort cleanly
definition_of_done: every derivation concept mapped or explicitly unmapped

conditions: an error class needs a linguistic ruling (e.g. contested wazn)
fixture disagreement with an existing eval row
escalation_trigger.route: Sol integration review -> owner adjudication where a rule/status change is implied

evidence_policy.fabrication_rule: never invent an example, answer key or analysis the source or an independent authority does not support; abstain and record the gap
evidence_policy.statement: evidence level: curriculum-source-supported (uncertified); every row cites its claim-ledger claim_id and manifest file_id (source + claim identity); lesson prose is read in private custody and never committed; committed rows are original restatements

expected_outputs.description: original candidate fixtures (positive + adversarial per class)

guards: the METHOD transfers, linguistic conclusions never do: a lesson-derived pattern licenses a candidate row, never a resolved analysis at any occurrence
rival-analysis handling: any item admitting more than one admissible analysis is recorded with ALL alternatives (analysis-dependent / school-dependent), never side-picked
no candidate-to-certified automatic promotion: nothing this packet produces may carry status certified; only tools/certify_typed_fact.py certifies, after review, outside this packet

non_deployment.statement: All outputs are candidate-plane repo artifacts; no live surface, entry store, or public payload is touched; deployment is owner-gated elsewhere.

scope.summary: The 113-row nominal-derivative-error eval bank has NO consumer (TP-SARF-A1-DERIVATIVE-CONSUMER). The curriculum's L3 derivation modules are the largest staged instructional treatment of exactly that capability. Produce a graded concept->eval-row crosswalk and ORIGINAL candidate fixture rows (restated, clean-room) so the consumer, when built, trains/validates against curriculum-informed graded difficulty.

title: Stage the L3 derivation modules as graded evidence for the future wazn/derivative classifier
tools_required: the PRIVATE lesson corpus (owner custody) for any step that reads lesson bodies; metadata-only steps run from committed artifacts
